hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */CLAUDE.md|CLAUDE.md) jq -n '{systemMessage: "Reminder: CLAUDE.md changed — verify AGENTS.md still points at it, and check whether new content needs anything called out separately for Codex or other agent CLIs.", hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: "CLAUDE.md was just edited. AGENTS.md points at CLAUDE.md but also carries its own review-board-portability section — confirm it still resolves correctly, and flag anything Codex-specific that this change should surface."}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null

jq -r '[.session_id, (.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path)] | join("|")' | { IFS='|' read -r sid f; case "$f" in *.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml|.claude/*|.vscode/*|*.config.*|.env*|*.lock|README*|.prettierrc*|.eslintrc*|tsconfig*) : ;; *) rm -f "/tmp/claude-cinder-nudge-${sid}" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null

jq -r '.session_id' | { read -r sid; f="/tmp/claude-cinder-nudge-${sid}"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then touch "$f"; ex=(':!*.json' ':!*.md' ':!*.yml' ':!*.yaml' ':!.claude' ':!.vscode' ':!*.config.*' ':!.env*' ':!*.lock' ':!README*' ':!.prettierrc*' ':!.eslintrc*' ':!tsconfig*'); diff=$(git diff HEAD -- . "${ex[@]}" 2>/dev/null | head -c 20000); untracked=$(git status --short -- . "${ex[@]}" 2>/dev/null | grep '^??' | sed 's/^?? //'); prompt="Before wrapping up: review the diff and new files below for hacks, workarounds, or silent accommodations around @lostgradient/cinder, chat, editor, markdown, cinder-mcp, conversationalist, or armorer (undocumented behavior, awkward import ordering, manual peer-dependency installs, forced type casts, style/layer ordering fixes, etc.). If you find one, file it per CLAUDE.md's File-in-Linear-first convention rather than leaving it undocumented — both owning repos have a Linear team today, so cinder/chat/editor/markdown/cinder-mcp issues go to team CIN and conversationalist/armorer issues go to team AB, and, when the work that surfaced it is itself tracked by a Linear issue, a native blocked by relation from that issue (check it is not a duplicate of #753/#754 first). gh issue create is the fallback only for a repository with no owning Linear team. Read the created issue back rather than trusting the write call: for Linear, re-read the issue and confirm the relation; for GitHub, verify with gh issue view NUMBER --repo OWNER/REPO --json state. Do not assume a posted comment keeps an issue open or counts as tracked, and if your comment says a problem still reproduces while the issue shows closed, reopen it with a short note rather than leaving a closed issue as the only record of an unresolved bug."; jq -n --arg prompt "$prompt" --arg diff "$diff" --arg untracked "$untracked" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "Stop", additionalContext: ($prompt + "

Uncommitted diff (excludes config/docs, truncated at 20000 chars):
" + (if ($diff|length) > 0 then $diff else "(none)" end) + "

Untracked new files (excludes config/docs):
" + (if ($untracked|length) > 0 then $untracked else "(none)" end))}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null
